usageNotes: Use this to update an existing LDAP realm's connection settings, bind credentials, sync behavior, or TLS mode in Proxmox Datacenter Manager; the realm must already exist (use the corresponding POST to create it). Requires the `Realm.Allocate` privilege on `/access/domains`. Pass the `digest` field (obtained from the GET) to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other.

examples.summary: Switch an existing LDAP realm to LDAPS with certificate verification, update the bind password, and enable new users on sync

tips: The `delete` param accepts a list of property names to unset (revert to default) in the same request — useful for removing a stale `capath` or `filter` without a separate call.
Default LDAP port is 389; LDAPS is 636 — set `port` explicitly when changing `mode` to avoid connection failures.
Setting `default: true` makes this realm pre-selected on the PDM login page; only one realm can be the default at a time.
The `sync-attributes` mapping uses LDAP attribute names as values (e.g. `email=mail`), not the reverse — easy to mix up.
When switching from plain `ldap` to `ldaps` or `ldap+starttls`, also set `verify: true` and supply a `capath` unless the server cert is signed by a trusted system CA.
